title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Fully Leveraging the Role of Judicial Functions to Promote the Development of New-type Urbanization
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Giving Full Play to the Adjudicative Functions to Promote the Development of New-Type Urbanization

Fa Fa [2014] No. 20

New-type urbanization is an inevitable requirement for promoting comprehensive social progress and a major strategic deployment for national economic and social development during the "Twelfth Five-Year Plan" period. In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Third and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 18th Central Committee, and the Central Urbanization Work Conference, and to give full play to the adjudicative functions to promote the development of new-type urbanization, the following opinions are hereby proposed.

I. Raise Ideological Understanding and Strengthen the Sense of Responsibility and Mission for Ensuring New-Type Urbanization

1. Fully recognize the significance of promoting new-type urbanization. Urbanization is an essential path to modernization, an important way to solve issues concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, a strong support for promoting coordinated regional development, and a key lever for expanding domestic demand and promoting industrial upgrading. At present, China is in an important period of economic transformation, upgrading, and accelerated modernization, and also a critical period for the in-depth development of urbanization. Actively, steadily, solidly, and orderly advancing new-type urbanization has great practical significance and far-reaching historical importance for building a moderately prosperous society in all respects, accelerating the process of socialist modernization, and realizing the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

2. Effectively strengthen the sense of responsibility for giving full play to the adjudicative functions to ensure new-type urbanization. Promoting new-type urbanization involves politics, economy, society, culture, ecological civilization construction, and many other aspects. Adjudicative work will inevitably face more new situations, new tasks, and new requirements. We must deeply understand the significant importance of new-type urbanization to economic and social development, deeply grasp the various decisions and deployments of the Central Committee on promoting new-type urbanization, place adjudicative work within the overall economic and social development, continuously enhance the sense of responsibility and service awareness, give full play to the adjudicative functions, effectively resolve conflicts and disputes using the thinking and methods of the rule of law, promptly and properly handle various interest conflicts arising in the process of new-type urbanization, and provide strong judicial guarantees for the advancement of the national new-type urbanization strategy and the harmonious development of the economy and society.

II. Protect the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Migrant Agricultural Populations and Help All Residents Fairly Share the Achievements of Modernization

3. Protect the basic public service rights of migrant agricultural populations in accordance with the law. Closely monitor the adjustment of relevant national policies, adhere to the principles of lawfulness, equality, and gradual progress, properly hear civil and administrative dispute cases involving basic public services such as education and training, employment and entrepreneurship, social security, and public health, give full play to the guiding role of the judiciary, promote the gradual resolution of the issue of migrant agricultural populations who work and live in cities but have not settled their household registration equally enjoying urban basic public services, and truly realize the integration of migrant agricultural populations into enterprises, their children into schools, families into communities, and groups into society.

4. Promote the expansion of housing security channels for migrant agricultural populations in accordance with the law. Properly hear civil and administrative dispute cases involving basic housing security, especially carefully handle rights disputes arising from collective economic organizations using rural collective construction land to build public rental housing, development zones and industrial parks building public rental housing, and enterprises building collective dormitories for migrant workers. Strengthen the understanding and grasp of relevant legal provisions, accurately assess national policy directions, and pay attention to strengthening communication with relevant administrative departments, effectively resolving conflicts and disputes through various means.

III. Serve Industrial Transformation and Upgrading and Enhance the Industrial Support Capacity of New-Type Urbanization

5. Protect the rights and interests of investors in accordance with the law and serve the optimization and adjustment of the economic structure. When hearing various types of investment dispute cases, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors, promote the diversification of social investment entities, give full play to the guiding role of judicial judgments, encourage capital to flow to new energy, new materials, energy conservation and environmental protection, biomedicine, information networks, and high-end manufacturing industries, support and guide the vigorous development of strategic emerging industries, and enhance economic vitality.

6. Create a favorable financing and entrepreneurship environment. Properly hear non-financial lending dispute cases, correctly determine the validity of non-financial lending contracts, while maintaining financial security and social stability, protect lawful private lending and enterprise financing activities, safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of creditors, broaden financing channels for enterprises, especially small and micro enterprises, and promote the healthy development of enterprises.

7. Ensure the development of the modern service industry in accordance with the law. For service contract dispute cases involving tourism, telecommunications, logistics, information, research and development, industrial design, business, energy conservation, and environmental protection, reasonably balance the interests of service providers and consumers. While supporting and ensuring the development of the modern service industry oriented towards production and serving people's livelihoods, promptly correct improper conduct of service providers, regulate and guide service providers to continuously improve operational management and service levels. Strengthen information exchange with competent service industry departments and industry associations, promptly report problems found in the development of the service industry during case trials, and propose judicial suggestions.

8. Promote the standardized and healthy development of the labor market. Properly hear labor dispute cases between workers and employers during the process of industrial transformation and upgrading, protect the legitimate rights and interests of workers in accordance with the law, and regulate the labor employment system. Focus on resolving disputes through mediation, conciliation, and other methods, and strive for mutual benefit and win-win results between employers and workers.

IV. Promote New-Type Urban Construction and Enhance Comprehensive Carrying Capacity of Cities and Towns

9. Create a favorable legal environment for the lawful and orderly development of new-type urban construction. Properly handle civil and administrative cases arising from urban function zones, municipal public facilities, transportation networks, and other infrastructure construction, as well as shantytown renovation, dilapidated and old housing and non-whole housing renovation, new residential area construction, and other residential area construction during the urbanization process, including land acquisition, urban house demolition, and urban and rural demolition of illegal structures. Pay close attention to the acquisition and compensation of remaining collective land after "agricultural to non-agricultural household registration conversion," "village to residents' committee conversion," and "group cancellation and household transfer." Strictly implement the standards for land acquisition and house demolition compensation and resettlement, protect the legitimate rights and interests of those relocated, and at the same time, support urban construction in accordance with the law, providing high-quality judicial guarantees for the orderly and efficient advancement of urban construction.

10. Serve the advancement of new-type urban construction in accordance with the law and promote the enhancement of the service function of urban carriers. Properly resolve conflicts and disputes such as construction projects and labor disputes occurring during the construction of urban function zones, municipal public facilities, transportation networks, and other infrastructure. Equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of all parties in accordance with the law, maintain safe and standardized market order in the construction market and labor market, ensure urban infrastructure construction, and enhance the capacity to support population agglomeration and services.

V. Strengthen the Trial of Cases Involving Ecological and Environmental Protection and Promote Green Development in Urban and Rural Areas

11. Strengthen judicial protection of urban and rural ecological environment. Pay close attention to environmental protection issues such as resource development, soil pollution, air pollution, water pollution, and noise pollution prevention and control. Strengthen the trial of environmental resource cases, and sanction illegal acts that pollute and harm the environment in accordance with the law. Properly hear environmental tort dispute cases arising in the urbanization process, correctly apply the rules for the distribution of burden of proof, and accurately determine the causal relationship between environmental pollution and damage consequences. Actively improve the environmental public interest litigation system, explore the establishment of a working mechanism for properly handling major environmental pollution claims cases, protect the legitimate rights and interests of victims in accordance with the law, and safeguard ecological and environmental security.

12. Promote the formation of a good social atmosphere for ecological and environmental protection. Actively implement the principle of public participation in environmental resource trials, improve the system for people's assessors to participate in the trial of environmental resource cases, and through various means such as law enforcement, case handling, and legal publicity, vigorously promote the basic state policies of resource conservation and environmental protection, and vigorously publicize policies and laws concerning land and resource development, intensive resource utilization, and development of a circular economy. Guide the people to enhance ecological awareness, conservation awareness, and environmental protection awareness, and promote the formation of a good social atmosphere where everyone is responsible for environmental protection.

VI. Serve the Integration of Urban and Rural Development and Enhance the Vitality of Rural Development

13. Ensure the implementation of equal employment and equal pay for equal work in accordance with the law. Further give play to the adjudicative function, strictly adjudicate cases in accordance with the provisions of labor security laws and administrative regulations, including the new Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance and their judicial interpretations, in all aspects such as working conditions, production safety, labor remuneration, and work-related injury, medical, and endowment insurance. Assist in the gradual realization of the goal of complete equality between urban and rural workers, protect the legitimate rights and interests of all workers in participating in new-type urbanization construction, and promote the establishment of a unified urban-rural human resources market.

14. Promote the formation of a unified urban-rural construction land market. Under the premise of compliance with land use planning and use control, equally protect the equal rights of collective operational construction land and state-owned land in accordance with the law. When hearing cases involving disputes over collective operational construction land, strictly implement laws and administrative regulations while properly handling the relationship between laws, administrative regulations, and policies as well as institutional and mechanism innovations.

15. Maintain market order for agricultural infrastructure construction projects. Further strengthen the trial of cases involving agricultural infrastructure construction projects, increase the protection of the interests of investors in small-scale farmland water conservancy facilities, small watershed comprehensive management, and other construction projects, and pay attention to protecting the enthusiasm and initiative of farmers in participating in agricultural infrastructure construction.

16. Carefully handle agricultural land disputes and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of farmers. When hearing civil dispute cases involving rural land acquisition compensation, rural collective land use right transfer, and the like, respect the autonomy of the parties, focus on guiding the parties to reach agreements balancing rights and obligations through voluntary negotiation. Where issues involve the definition of qualifications for membership in rural collective organizations, maximize the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of farmers, especially rural elderly, women, and children, within the framework of existing legal provisions. Strictly comply with national laws and regulations, fairly determine the scope of rights and obligations of the parties in accordance with the law. Judicial judgments must be lawful and reasonable, and consider the demonstration effect of individual cases, avoiding the triggering of mass incidents due to individual case judgments.

17. Strengthen judicial protection of arable land and effectively ensure food security. Properly hear cases involving disputes over arable land, especially basic farmland, adhere to the strictest arable land protection system and the strictest land conservation system, ensure the realization of the arable land protection goals of "use control, economical use, and strict management," resolutely hold the red line of arable land protection, and ensure national food security.

18. Promote the development of modern agricultural industrialization. Closely monitor and comprehensively grasp the spirit of national policies, coordinate and balance the relationship between maintaining land contractual management rights and promoting the transfer of land contractual management rights. Properly hear disputes arising from the transfer and mutually beneficial exchange of land contractual management rights. Following the principle of being conducive to both the orderly and standardized transfer of land contractual management rights and the full protection of farmers' various legitimate rights and interests in land contracting, encourage and support the transfer of land to specialized large households, family farms, and farmer cooperatives. Lawfully and properly hear various types of new-type dispute cases emerging in the development of modern agriculture, ensure the construction of facility agriculture, ecological agriculture, and sightseeing agriculture, and promote the accelerated development of green, high-quality, and safe modern urban agriculture.

19. Ensure the improvement of the agricultural product circulation system. Strengthen the trial of cases involving disputes at all stages of agricultural product production, processing, packaging, transportation, and sales. Clarify the rights and obligations of all parties in the process of agricultural product circulation. While protecting the personal safety and property rights of agricultural product consumers, adhere to the principle of each party bearing its own responsibility, clearly define the respective responsibilities of agricultural product purchasers, transporters, processors, and sellers, and promote the construction of a safe, efficient, and convenient agricultural product circulation system.

20. Promote the construction of beautiful villages. For rural civil and administrative disputes, be adept at leveraging various social forces such as village cadres and judicial assistants, make every effort to conduct mediation, and strive for case closure, matter resolution, and harmony among people. Properly resolve conflicts and disputes arising from rural road networking, rural electrification, and rural environmental improvement. Guide farmers to pursue scientific, healthy, civilized, and low-carbon production and lifestyle.

VII. Improve Working Mechanisms and Enhance the Targetability and Effectiveness of Judicial Guarantees

21. Perfect and improve the efficient trial work system. Deeply promote judicial openness, continuously improve various rapid dispute resolution mechanisms for disputes related to new-type urbanization construction, and timely protect the lawful interests and claims of the people. For litigation cases involving key projects in new-type urbanization construction, open efficient and fast litigation channels within the existing legal framework to ensure the smooth progress of new-type urbanization construction to the greatest extent.

22. Participate in social governance in accordance with the law. For conflicts and disputes arising during the construction of new-type urbanization, follow the principle of "no absence, no overstepping, no misplacement," strengthen communication and cooperation with other state organs, grassroots organizations, and mass self-governing organizations, support them in mediating social conflicts and disputes in accordance with the law, guide the People's Mediation Committees to mediate civil disputes in accordance with the law, and for parties who have reached a mediation agreement through people's mediation and jointly apply for judicial confirmation, handle the judicial confirmation work in accordance with the law. Attach great importance to and seriously study new situations and new problems found in the trial of cases involving disputes related to new-type urbanization construction, promptly submit special reports to local Party committees and People's Congresses, and propose judicial suggestions to the government and other relevant departments.

23. Implement measures for judicial service to the people and convenience for the people. Deepen the litigation service mechanism, continue to promote convenient measures such as circuit trials, community courts, holiday courts, and street litigation service stations. Use information technology to vigorously improve judicial convenience measures for the people, and fully build a comprehensive convenience service platform covering case filing, trial, and enforcement. Provide procedural notifications and evidence presentation guidance, offer necessary assistance to parties with weaker litigation capacity, maximize the timely resolution of conflicts and disputes arising in the urbanization process, and eliminate social discordant factors. Increase judicial assistance, provide necessary help to parties with genuine financial difficulties. Actively explore special working mechanisms such as "protection of the rights and interests of migrant workers" and "mediation of disputes involving rural farmers' rights and interests," comprehensively use multiple dispute resolution mechanisms, judicial green channels, judicial assistance, and other mechanisms to effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of farmers.

November 14, 2014
